result.reason: The operative addition reaches the preferred position: Licensee may terminate on 30 days' written notice without an early-termination charge and receives a refund of prepaid fees allocable to the post-termination period. Licensor receives no convenience-termination right during the committed term. However, permitting termination 'in whole or in part' adds a substantive partial-termination right not required by the playbook and creates some uncertainty regarding the scope and calculation of refunds. The unimplemented margin-comment request to limit breach termination does not defeat compliance with this T4C rule.
